"I like them"
is that so hard to say?

rows.05:5204:
But the next day, that teacher died.
A sudden heart attack, or so I heard.
And in exchange, apparently, Ishikawa's grandma, who'd been bedridden, got better.
Can you believe it?
If that's true, then Ishikawa could even swap people's lifespans.
A guy like him having a power like that... honestly, it was criminal.
Everyone thought so, but nobody could say it out loud.
Then one day, it happened.{p}
rows.05:6adc:
...What happened to Ishikawa after that?
He moved away right after.
So I couldn't tell you.
But I did see him right before the teachers took him away.
He was in a daze, like his whole personality had fallen apart.
He'd held the heart of the girl he loved in his hand.
That'd be a shock.
He'll probably never forget it as long as he lives.
...Yeah, I don't think I'll ever forget that sight either.{p}
rows.05:6f4c:
Have you all noticed what's here right now?
I don't mean the ones sitting in their seats, quietly listening to the seven wonders.
I mean the ones that snuck in while we've been sitting here talking.
...Come on, don't make that weird face.
You say nobody came into this room?
That's right, not in any form you can see.
But they're here.
{a}, you look like you've got a strong sixth sense.
You'd be able to tell, wouldn't you?
Talk about stuff like this at this school, and of course they're going to gather.
Well, most of them just drift around and can't lay a finger on people.
But some of them are powerful.
What if I told you one of them was watching you... would you believe me?{p}
